# Tarumak Studio — Complete AI Sitemap

> Full inventory of all tools and articles on tarumakstudio.com for AI assistants. For a short summary, see llms.txt.

## Image Tools

- [Image Compressor](https://tarumakstudio.com/image-compressor): Compress JPG, PNG and WebP images online — reduce file size by up to 80% with no visible quality loss. Free, browser-based, no uploads.
- [Compress Image to Exact KB](https://tarumakstudio.com/image-converter): Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, GIF and BMP images to JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF. Convert many at once, download as ZIP. Free and private, no upload.
- [Compress Image to Exact KB](https://tarumakstudio.com/compress-image-to-exact-kb): Compress a JPG, PNG or WebP image to a target size such as 20, 50 or 100 KB. Free and private: it runs in your browser and shows the real file size.
- [Image Resizer](https://tarumakstudio.com/image-resizer): Resize images to exact pixel dimensions or percentage online. Batch resize multiple images while keeping the original aspect ratio.
- [Image Cropper](https://tarumakstudio.com/image-cropper): Crop images online to any custom size or preset ratio (1:1, 16:9, 4:3). Preview before downloading — no software needed.
- [JPG to PNG Converter](https://tarumakstudio.com/jpg-to-png): Convert JPG to PNG online for free. Preserve transparency and get lossless quality — instant conversion, no uploads.
- [PNG to JPG Converter](https://tarumakstudio.com/png-to-jpg): Convert PNG to JPG online to reduce file size for web and email. Adjust quality level before downloading.
- [JPG to WebP Converter](https://tarumakstudio.com/jpg-to-webp): Convert JPG to WebP online — get files 25–35% smaller than JPG with the same visual quality. Works in all modern browsers.
- [WebP to JPG Converter](https://tarumakstudio.com/webp-to-jpg): Convert WebP images to JPG online for compatibility with older software, email clients and social media platforms.
- [PNG to WebP Converter](https://tarumakstudio.com/png-to-webp): Convert PNG to WebP online and save up to 26% file size. Keeps transparency. Ideal for web performance and Core Web Vitals.
- [WebP to PNG Converter](https://tarumakstudio.com/webp-to-png): Convert WebP to PNG for full compatibility with all image editors, design tools and platforms that do not yet support WebP.
- [SVG to PNG](https://tarumakstudio.com/svg-to-jpg?format=png): Convert SVG files to transparent PNG in the SVG converter, at 256 to 2048 px wide.
- [SVG to JPG Converter](https://tarumakstudio.com/svg-to-jpg): Convert SVG to JPG or PNG online. Choose the output size, JPG quality, or PNG to keep transparency.
- [Image to PDF Converter](https://tarumakstudio.com/image-to-pdf): Convert JPG or PNG images to a PDF document online. Combine multiple images into one PDF in seconds — no software needed.
- [Watermark Image Tool](https://tarumakstudio.com/watermark-image): Add a text or image watermark to photos online. Adjust opacity, size and position. Protect your images before sharing.
- [EXIF Data Remover](https://tarumakstudio.com/exif-remover): Remove EXIF metadata from photos to protect your privacy. Strips GPS location, camera model and timestamps from JPG files.
- [QR Code Generator](https://tarumakstudio.com/qr-code-generator): Generate a free QR code for any URL, text, email or phone number. Download as high-resolution PNG — no sign-up required.
- [PNG to SVG Converter](https://tarumakstudio.com/png-to-svg): Convert PNG logos, icons and simple graphics into clean, editable SVG vectors with intelligent tracing — free and fully in-browser.
- [AI Object Remover](https://tarumakstudio.com/ai-object-remover): Remove unwanted objects, people, text, wires and watermarks from photos. Paint over anything and the background rebuilds itself — free, in your browser.
- [AI Photo Enhancer](https://tarumakstudio.com/ai-photo-enhancer): Enhance photos automatically: fix exposure, color, noise and sharpness with intelligent auto-analysis in your browser. Presets for portraits, night shots, documents and old photos.
- [AI Image Upscaler](https://tarumakstudio.com/ai-image-upscaler): Upscale images 2x or 4x with AI directly in your browser. Enlarge photos, art and product shots with sharp edges and preserved detail — no upload, free.
- [Background Remover](https://tarumakstudio.com/background-remover): Remove backgrounds from images automatically using AI. Works on people, products, logos and objects. Downloads as transparent PNG.
- [OCR Image to Text](https://tarumakstudio.com/ocr-image-to-text): Extract text from any image — screenshots, scanned documents or photos of signs. Powered by Tesseract.js in your browser.
- [HEIC to JPG Converter](https://tarumakstudio.com/heic-to-jpg): Convert iPhone HEIC and HEIF photos to JPG or PNG online. Batch convert multiple files at once — no upload, no server, all in your browser.

## PDF Tools

- [PDF Merger](https://tarumakstudio.com/pdf-merger): Merge multiple PDF files into one online for free. Drag to reorder pages before combining — no uploads, no sign-up.
- [PDF Splitter](https://tarumakstudio.com/pdf-splitter): Split a PDF into separate pages or extract a specific page range online. Download as individual PDFs instantly.
- [PDF Compressor](https://tarumakstudio.com/pdf-compressor): Compress PDF file size online for free. Reduce large PDFs for email attachments and web uploads — all in your browser.
- [PDF to JPG Converter](https://tarumakstudio.com/pdf-to-jpg): Convert PDF pages to JPG images online. Extract every page as a high-quality image — free, fast and private.
- [JPG to PDF Converter](https://tarumakstudio.com/jpg-to-pdf): Convert JPG images to PDF online in seconds. Combine multiple JPGs into one PDF or convert individually.
- [PNG to PDF Converter](https://tarumakstudio.com/png-to-pdf): Convert PNG images to PDF online. Preserves transparency as white background. Merge multiple PNGs into one document.
- [PDF to Text Converter](https://tarumakstudio.com/pdf-to-text): Extract text from a PDF file online. Convert PDF to plain TXT for editing, copying or analysis — no software needed.
- [PDF Password Protector](https://tarumakstudio.com/pdf-password-protect): Add password protection to a PDF online. Encrypt your PDF before sharing to prevent unauthorised access.
- [PDF Unlock Tool](https://tarumakstudio.com/pdf-unlock): Remove the password from a PDF you own. Creates an unlocked copy that opens and prints without a password.
- [PDF Page Rotator](https://tarumakstudio.com/pdf-page-rotator): Rotate PDF pages online — rotate individual pages or the entire document 90° or 180°. Download the corrected PDF.
- [PDF Page Remover](https://tarumakstudio.com/pdf-page-remover): Delete specific pages from a PDF online. Enter page numbers or ranges and download the PDF with those pages removed.
- [PDF Organizer](https://tarumakstudio.com/pdf-organizer): Reorder PDF pages online with drag-and-drop thumbnail view. Rearrange, rotate and preview before downloading.
- [Scan to PDF Tool](https://tarumakstudio.com/scan-to-pdf): Scan documents to PDF using your device camera. Capture multiple pages and merge them into a single PDF file.
- [Multiple Images to PDF](https://tarumakstudio.com/images-to-pdf): Convert multiple images to a single PDF online. Drag in JPG, PNG or WebP files, reorder them and download.
- [PDF Reader Web App](https://tarumakstudio.com/pdf-reader): Read and view PDF files online without downloading software. Navigate pages and zoom in — all in your browser.
- [PDF to Excel Converter](https://tarumakstudio.com/pdf-to-excel): Convert PDF tables to Excel (.xlsx) online. Reconstructs rows and columns from real text positions, with OCR for scanned pages — free, private, no upload.

- [Favicon Generator](https://tarumakstudio.com/favicon-generator): Generate favicons for your website from any image. Creates all required sizes (16x16 to 512x512) — free, instant.

- [GIF Compressor](https://tarumakstudio.com/gif-compressor): Compress animated GIFs online for free. Reduce file size while preserving animation — browser-based, privacy-first, no uploads.
